notes: Global Economic Prospects and the Developing Countries 1995: short-term update. Annex C, Table C.1 World and Major Regions: Growth of Real GDP (in constant 1987 U.S. dollars), page 49 of https://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/446141492622943161/pdf/multi0page.pdf, a scanned report. Read by OCR: tesseract at 400 dpi agrees with the PDF text layer for every value; World and low- and middle-income growth also agree with the edition's Table 1 (page 7). Table note: In constant 1987 U.S. dollars. Low and middle income includes Eastern Europe and the former Soviet Union; Sub-Saharan Africa includes the Republic of South Africa. Values as printed (1 decimal); aggregates use the World Bank grouping and 1987 weights of that edition. Published month: source line "International Economics Department, August 1995". Not captured: none of the scope slots but Advanced/EMDE groups, which did not exist; Germany and sub-regional rows are not captured.
